title: Various fixes and improvements, mostly Clash Arena

texts: Community Asset upload restriction for new accounts has been changed from 1 week to 30 days.
Clash Arena: Added the ability for the host to force advance the current draft/round in Standard mode.
Clash Arena: Changed the layout of the skill select menu to reduce the vertical shifting of the menu layout while selecting skills.
Clash Arena: Adjusted the layout for mobile. It's still not optimized or even designed for mobile, but it should now be possible to at least see and select skills.
Clash Arena: Added a display for some of the game settings in the drafting screen.
Clash Arena: Added a few additional alert options to Clash Arena.
Clash Arena: Added a spectating feature
Clash Arena: Made balance changes to the point system and identities with bonus skill uses. Details can be found on the page itself.
Community Trivia: Other answers are now limited to 10 per question. These are the incorrect answers for multiple choice and alternative answers for short answer.
Added the ability to move the chat window.
Added a short 4 character identifier when hovering over usernames in the chat widget.
Fixed the chat window resize not working on mobile.
Fixed Crimson God Sinclair's skills missing their atk weight modifiers.
Added the no AI-generated code disclaimer in the sidebar.
